# MIDI-grep

> Go CLI + web app that extracts musical content from audio files / YouTube videos and generates
> [Strudel](https://strudel.dygy.app) live-coding code. Go orchestrates the pipeline; Python does audio
> analysis & ML; Node/TypeScript renders Strudel to audio for verification. The product path is
> `scripts/editable-pipeline.sh` (editable Strudel, replay forbidden, vocals never generated); the system
> **never hardcodes** synthesis values — everything is learned from analysis.

## Core idea

Input (WAV/MP3/YouTube) → stem separation (Demucs) → analysis (librosa: BPM, key, chords) →
Strudel code (editable pipeline: `generate_dynamic_strudel.py` + measured calibration; `midi-grep extract`:
LLM codegen via Ollama/Claude) → render to audio → compare to original → iterate to improve similarity. All outputs cached in `.cache/stems/{key}/` with output versioning (v001, …).

## Pipelines (modes)

- **Standard** — note transcription (Basic Pitch); best for piano/melodic.
- **Chord** (`--chords`) — chord-progression detection; best for electronic/EDM/funk.
- **Brazilian Funk** (`--brazilian-funk`, auto-detected) — tamborzão + 808 template.
- **Generative** (`generative` cmd) — trains RAVE/granular neural synths for full note() control.
- **Editable** (`scripts/editable-pipeline.sh`, the product path) — `sample-instrument` and `synth` pieces; see below.
- **Sample-pack** (`scripts/sample-pipeline.sh`, predecessor) — slice the REAL extracted stems into a Strudel
  sample pack (per-bar loops + drum one-shots + pitched samples), host it (localhost or Cloudflare
  R2), and play via `await samples(...)`. Its `loops` mode is replay (forbidden as a deliverable,
  `values.md` A1); its old-scale ~91% is not comparable. The base URL is the only thing that changes localhost↔R2.

## Key directories

- `cmd/midi-grep/main.go` — CLI entrypoint (extract, serve, generative).
- `internal/pipeline/orchestrator.go` — end-to-end pipeline; calls Python AI for codegen.
- `internal/{audio,analysis,midi,cache,report,drums,generative}/` — Go domain packages.
- `scripts/python/` — audio analysis, comparison, and LLM codegen (the brains).
- `scripts/node/src/` — TypeScript Strudel renderers.
- `eval/` — similarity gate (`thresholds.yaml`) + reference-track datasets.
- `scripts/python/editability_check.py` — the editability/replay detector (spec 003 Slice 1): static
  rules R1–R6 over a `.strudel` file; exit 0 pass / 1 fail / 2 parse error; `--json` emits
  `editability`, `generation_mode`, voice counts. v023's `vocalsfull` voice FAILS it (replay, values.md A1).
- `.awos/`, `.claude/` — agent workflow (commands, skills, domain-expert subagents).
- `.sisyphus/` — durable plan + evidence orchestration for multi-step runs.

## Code generation (important)

**Go does NOT generate Strudel code.** The editable pipeline uses `generate_dynamic_strudel.py` (no LLM).
The `midi-grep extract` path is LLM-first:
- `scripts/python/ollama_codegen.py` — Ollama code gen with genre-aware sound RAG + per-genre sidechain instruction.
- `scripts/python/ollama_agent.py` — agentic LLM with per-track memory + RAG + code validation; feedback gives concrete per-voice gain multipliers from band diffs.
- `scripts/python/ai_improver.py` — iteration loop + ClickHouse learning storage.
- `scripts/python/synth_profiles.py` — per-genre synthesis profiles (bass/sub/master.hpf/transient) + sidechain depth, applied to `synth_config.json` via `analyze_synth_params.py --genre`.
Go's job: stem separation, BPM/key/genre detection, caching, orchestration.

## Rendering & comparison

- **Offline renderer** (`scripts/node/src/render-strudel-offline.ts`) — DEFAULT since 2026-10-19; Strudel's own
  `renderPatternAudio` into an OfflineAudioContext (real superdough engine, headless Chromium): sample-exact timing
  and pitch, no audio device. Deterministic (`determinism.ts`; two renders differ by ≤ 1 LSB), local sample cache
  (`sample-cache.ts`, `.cache/render-samples/`), hang watchdog. `MIDIGREP_RENDERER=offline|blackhole` (`scripts/python/renderer.py`).
- **BlackHole recorder** (`scripts/node/src/record-strudel-blackhole.ts`) — cross-check only; KNOWN DEFECT: ~12%
  sample loss + rate relabel → every pitch ~2.3–2.7 semitones flat.
- **Node.js synth** — REMOVED (Jun 2026). `render-strudel-node.ts` no longer exists.
- **`scripts/python/compare_audio.py`** — similarity via **MAE** on frequency bands (NOT cosine —
  cosine hid 20%+ band errors). Since 2026-10-18 overall = 0.5 × static (Freq 40%, MFCC 20%, Energy 15%,
  Brightness 15%, Tempo/Chroma 5%, time-averaged) + 0.5 × temporal (aligned frame-wise chroma/mel corr,
  onset F1 ±50 ms, envelope corr); `--control` = a different same-genre song the render must beat by 0.02.
  The old time-averaged score scored a different song 0.876 vs our 0.932 — pre-2026-10-18 numbers are old-scale.
  Reference-side features are cached (`compare_cache.py`, `.cache/compare-features/`, `MIDIGREP_COMPARE_CACHE=0` bypasses).
  Gate: `eval/gate.py --mode`; floors + the four reference tracks: `eval/thresholds.yaml` `modes:`, `eval/datasets/reference_tracks.yaml`.
- **`scripts/editable-pipeline.sh`** — ONE command from a YouTube link to both editable pieces, scored on
  real playback (spec 004): extract → MIDI per stem (bass/melodic; never vocals) → drum bands → sample pack → granular
  instruments (one grain per transcribed note, bass grains keep the stem's ring/808 tail, every sample pitch-verified; `build_instruments.py` manifest + `verification.json`) → R2/local host → `auto-calibrate.sh` (N iters) then `auto-calibrate.sh --mode synth`
  (starts from those knobs, own env correction) → `compare_audio --strudel` → `eval/gate.py` → `vNNN/` promotion → stage 10 report (`pipeline_helpers.py report`: charts, Demucs
  per-stem comparison, `iterations.json`, `report.html`; mandatory, `--no-iteration-stems`). Render stems come from the renderer itself (`solo_stems.py`: one voice group sounding per render), Demucs on the render only with `--render-stems demucs`. Pack and instruments are stamped with the code that built them (`calibration_memory.py code-version --stage pack|instruments`) and rebuilt when it changes; a missing renderer Chromium (`renderer.py browser`) stops the run before calibration. Reads bpm/key/genre from the
  track `metadata.json` (stamped by `pipeline_helpers.py stamp`, incl. CLAP genre with the bpm prior);
  `--genre` overrides are logged. Renders are OFFLINE by default (`render-strudel-offline.js`, Strudel's own
  renderPatternAudio; `MIDIGREP_RENDERER=blackhole` = cross-check, known ~2.5-semitone-flat defect) and are scored
  against `instrumental.wav` (bass+drums+melodic) — **vocals are never generated** (owner decision 2026-10-19).
  Tempo is phase-coherence-refined off librosa's tempogram bins (`tempo_refine.py`).
- **Section-aware diagnostics (fix #10):** `compare_audio.py` stores `comparison.section_windows` (per 10-s
  window mfcc/band/energy/win/rms/band_diff); `calibrate_dynamic.py --env-correction-out` derives per-bar
  bass/lead/master multipliers from them (damped, composable via `--env-correction-in`); the generator applies
  them with `--env-correction PATH`; `auto-calibrate.sh` chains it per iteration and keeps `best.env.json`.
- **`scripts/python/generate_dynamic_strudel.py`** — the editable generator (spec 003). `--mode
  {sample-instrument,synth}` (default sample-instrument; synth = palette sounds, no `samples()`),
  no vocal voice in either mode. Lead = the loudest transcribed note per step; `melodic_shape.py` strikes lead/chords
  only at the stem's onsets and holds to the next (`--melodic-shape stem|off`), stem pitch changes inside a hold are
  `leadLegato`/`chordsLegato` notes (no new attack); sample bass notes without a stem attack go to `bassLegato`; stem attacks the
  transcription missed are written (bass `bass_shape.py`, lead `melodic_shape.missed_attacks`); quiet transcribed
  harmony notes the stem's chroma sounds are kept; each sampled lead/chord note carries a per-note `.velocity()` measured
  from the melodic stem vs its grain (`note_dynamics.py`, `--lead-dynamics stem|off`); kicks get a per-hit `.speed()` from the stem hit's 808 pitch
  (`drum_pitch.py`). Header line `// generation_mode:`; runs
  `strudel_validation.validate_code` on its own output.
- **`scripts/python/calibrate_dynamic.py`** — data-driven mix calibrator: reads a render's
  `comparison.json` and emits the NEXT `generate_dynamic_strudel.py` knobs (sub-gain, bass-mult,
  cal-lead, lead-lpf, hat-gain, master-gain). Each knob is a damped proportional correction of a
  measured band/centroid ratio — no hardcoded per-track values. Brightness lever uses the spectral
  CENTROID (the 1%-magnitude high bands are too noisy in bass-heavy genres); when lead-lpf maxes
  out and the mix is still dark, it raises a TR808 hat layer (`--hat-gain`) — the hats carry the
  brightness the extracted lead can't.
- **`scripts/auto-calibrate.sh`** — runs the full generate→render(offline)→compare→calibrate
  loop, keeping the best render (BEST = gate-passing first, then largest minimum margin to the floors;
  `calibrate_loop.py`, noise = `calibration_noise`). Calibration memory in ClickHouse
  (`calibration_memory.py`, `midi_grep.calibration_steps`: warm start, learned step sizes; `--no-memory`/`AC_MEM=off`);
  outputs are stamped with `calibration_memory.py code-version` and rerun when the code changes. After BEST it runs the loudness
  stage (`scripts/python/mix_dynamics.py`): the score is level-invariant, so one measured lever,
  `--master-gain`, is moved onto the instrumental's RMS in up to 3 render→measure rounds (the output
  clips at full scale - npm superdough 1.3.0 has no master bus); kept only if RMS and crest match the
  reference and neither score drops more than `calibration_noise`; `--no-mix-dynamics` skips it. On an engine bundle
  with `setMasterLimiter`/`setMasterCompressor` (`MIDIGREP_STRUDEL_BUNDLE`) a master-bus stage follows.
  Each iteration also renders the BASS channel alone (`bass_solo.py`, `--bass-solo`, `AC_BSOLO=off` skips) and, in
  sample-instrument mode, LEAD+CHORDS alone (`melodic_solo.py`, `--melodic-solo`, `AC_MSOLO=off` skips): bass-mult,
  cal-lead and lead-lpf follow the voice's own level/centroid vs its stem, not whole-mix shares. `--lead-hpf 0` = derived.
  Those renders (mix, bass solo, melodic solo) are independent and run concurrently: `render_jobs.py` derives how many at once from
  cores + free memory vs one render's measured footprint (`MIDIGREP_RENDER_JOBS` overrides, logged as `render jobs:`; 1 = sequential;
  the report's three stem renders use the same limit); a failure or SIGINT/SIGTERM terminates every child process tree.

## Sample-pack → R2 (highest similarity)

- `scripts/python/build_sample_pack.py` — stems → drum one-shots (`drum_oneshots.py`: cut from the pattern's own detected hits, attack at sample 0, picked against the class's own median profile) + pitched bass/melodic + raw
  beat-aligned per-bar **loops** (drums/bass/melodic; never vocals). Loops are written RAW (un-normalized)
  to preserve dynamics + inter-stem balance — normalizing them drops reconstruction 99%→70%.
- `scripts/python/generate_sample_strudel.py` — writes host-resolved `samples.json` (absolute
  `_base` ending in `/` — Strudel concats `base+path` with no slash) + `output_<mode>.strudel`
  (modes: loops/instrument/hybrid). Strudel's loader only accepts ARRAY-valued entries.
- `scripts/python/upload_r2.py` — uploads pack to R2 via `aws s3 --endpoint-url` (R2 S3 keys) or
  `wrangler r2 object put` (wrangler login); env: R2_ACCOUNT_ID/R2_BUCKET/R2_PUBLIC_BASE/R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID/R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
- `scripts/sample-pipeline.sh --url <U>|--stems-dir <D> --prefix <id> [--mode loops] (--local|--r2)`
  — one-command orchestration: build → (serve+render+score | upload to R2 + retarget code).

## Build & run

```bash
go build -o bin/midi-grep ./cmd/midi-grep
scripts/editable-pipeline.sh --url "https://youtu.be/..."     # the product path (both modes, R2 hosting)
./bin/midi-grep extract --url "https://youtu.be/..."          # standard
./bin/midi-grep extract --url "..." --chords --iterate 5      # chord mode, 5 AI iterations
./bin/midi-grep serve --port 8080                             # web UI (Chi + HTMX)
```

## Working agreement

- See `CLAUDE.md` → "Working Agreement": one round of clarifying questions max, env preflight before
  long runs, self-review after edits, delegate to `.claude/agents/` domain experts.
- ZERO HARDCODING: gains/filters/effects come from analysis or the AI, never magic numbers.
